mapper.select: SELECT case_id,order_id,store_id,case_version,order_version,status,source_stage,source_json,created_at FROM order_aftersale_source_proof WHERE case_id=#{caseId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT order_id,store_id,case_id,decision_id,refund_order_id,order_version,refund_type,refund_amount,source_stage,funding_evidence_id,token,created_at,success_event_id,succeeded_at FROM order_aftersale_refund_commit WHERE order_id=#{order} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_operation_guard WHERE order_id=#{order} AND BINARY token=BINARY #{token} AND operation_type='CREATE_REFUND' AND status='COMMITTED'
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_order SET current_aftersale_id=#{case},aftersale_status='PENDING',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND refunded_amount=0

UPDATE pet_order SET aftersale_status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND current_aftersale_id=#{case} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND refund_order_id IS NULL
UPDATE order_aftersale_source_proof SET status=#{status},case_version=#{caseVersion},order_version=#{version} WHERE case_id=#{case} AND order_id=#{order} AND case_version=#{oldCaseVersion}
UPDATE order_operation_guard SET status='COMMITTED',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE order_id=#{order} AND token=#{token} AND operation_type='CREATE_REFUND' AND status='ACQUIRED'

UPDATE pet_order SET refund_order_id=#{refund},aftersale_status='RESOLVED',version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND current_aftersale_id=#{case} AND version=#{oldVersion} AND refund_order_id IS NULL AND refunded_amount=0

UPDATE pet_order SET refunded_amount=#{amount},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{order} AND store_id=#{store} AND refund_order_id=#{refund} AND refunded_amount=0 AND order_stage IN ('PENDING_SERVICE','COMPLETED') AND payment_status='PAID'
UPDATE order_aftersale_refund_commit SET success_event_id=#{event},succeeded_at=#{at} WHERE order_id=#{order} AND refund_order_id=#{refund} AND success_event_id IS NULL AND succeeded_at IS NULL
